map.计算语音导览讲解总时长，匹配展品数量与观众可用时间: Compute total audio-guide narration duration, matching exhibit count with visitor available time

map.📚 深度解析：语音导览时长规划: 📚 Deep Dive: Audio Guide Duration Planning
map.团队讲解排程时，按展品数、单件讲解时长、移动与开场时间估算总时长，判断是否在可用: When scheduling group tours, estimate total duration from exhibit count, per-exhibit narration time, movement and opening/closing time; judge whether it fits the available time and give trade-off suggestions.
map.个性化导览（逐件设置时长）场景下，列出每件展品时长占比与累计时间，对比可用时间识: In personalized tours (per-exhibit duration), list each exhibit time share and cumulative time, comparing with available time to identify over-time segments.
map.超时应急时，给出缩短单件讲解、减少展品数或压缩移动时间三种调控路径，保证团队整体: For overtime emergencies, give three adjustment paths: shorten per-exhibit narration, reduce exhibit count, or compress movement time, keeping the overall group pace.
map.某团队 5 件展品、单件讲解 120 秒、移动 30 秒/段、开场结束 60 秒: A team with 5 exhibits, 120 sec per exhibit narration, 30 sec movement per segment, 60 sec opening/closing, 20 min available. Total duration = 5×120 + 4×30 + 60 = 780 sec (13 min); available 20×60 = 1200 sec; time margin +420 sec (7 min surplus); per-exhibit available floor(1200÷5) = 240 sec. Per-exhibit scenario: bronze ding 120 / bianzhong 150 / jade bi disc 90 / pottery figurine 100 / gold-silver ware 110, total 570 sec; with 10 min (600 sec) available only 30 sec remain, so per-exhibit must be compressed or exhibits reduced.
map.工具给出三选一：①缩短单件讲解至 ⌊(可用−移动−开场)÷件数⌋ 秒；②减少讲解: The tool gives three options: 1) shorten per-exhibit narration to floor((available − movement − opening) ÷ count) sec; 2) reduce explained exhibits to floor((available − opening + movement) ÷ (per-exhibit + movement)) pieces; 3) compress movement time. Prioritize cutting redundant exhibits and movement gaps, keeping key halls.
map.快速估算：讲解总时长(秒) = 展品数 × 单件讲解秒数 + (展品数 > 1: Quick estimate: total narration seconds = exhibit count × per-exhibit seconds + (exhibit count > 1 ? (exhibit count − 1) × movement seconds per segment : 0) + opening/closing seconds; available seconds = available minutes × 60; time difference = available − total. Per-exhibit available = floor(available ÷ exhibit count) (0 when available is 0). Grades: difference ≥ 0 ample time, ≥ −300 s slightly overtime, otherwise severely overtime. Overtime adjustment values: per-exhibit narration should be cut to floor((available − total movement − opening/closing) ÷ exhibit count) sec (floor 0); suggested exhibit count = floor((available − opening/closing + movement seconds) ÷ (per-exhibit seconds + movement seconds)). Detail mode sums each exhibit's actual seconds and gives each share = per-exhibit seconds ÷ total × 100% with cumulative time. Time formatting: hours = floor(sec ÷ 3600), minutes = floor((sec mod 3600) ÷ 60), seconds = sec mod 60; if hours > 0 output "Xh Ym Zs", else if minutes > 0 output "Ym Zs", else "Zs"
map.平均每件时长怎么用？: How to use the average per-exhibit duration?
map.每件可用 = ⌊可用秒÷展品数⌋，用于快速判断当前单件设定是否超标；若某件远超均: Per-exhibit available = floor(available sec ÷ exhibit count), used to quickly judge whether the current per-exhibit setting exceeds the limit; if one far exceeds the average, prioritize compressing it. The per-exhibit view also shows each item share and cumulative time, easing precise trimming.
map.关于「导览时长匹配」: About the Audio Guide Duration Matcher
map.按展品数量、单件讲解时长、展品间移动与开场/结束语计算导览总时长，并与观众可用时: Compute total audio-guide duration from exhibit count, per-exhibit narration, walking time and opening/closing remarks, then compare it with the visitor's available time and flag overruns; per-exhibit custom durations are supported.
map.可用时间需大于 0，无法排程。: Available time must be greater than 0; scheduling is not possible.

map.②开场结束已占满可用时间，无法再安排讲解；: ② Opening and closing remarks already fill the available time, leaving no room for narration;
map.快速估算：讲解总时长(秒) = 展品数 × 单件讲解秒数 + (展品数 &gt;: Quick estimate: total narration seconds = exhibit count × per-exhibit narration + (exhibit count − 1) × walking seconds when count > 1, otherwise 0, plus opening/closing seconds. Available seconds = minutes × 60. Difference = available − total. Available per exhibit = floor(available ÷ count); exhibit count must be an integer ≥ 1. Blank, negative or fractional count/narration/walking/opening/available inputs produce only a correction prompt and no calculation; a negative difference is shown with a minus sign. Rating: ≥ 0 ample, ≥ −300 seconds slightly overtime, otherwise seriously overtime. Overtime adjustments: shorten each stop to floor((available − walking total − opening/closing) ÷ count), with a floor of 0; suggested exhibit count = floor((available − opening/closing + walking) ÷ (per-exhibit + walking)). Detail mode sums actual seconds and shows each share and cumulative time. Time format: hours, minutes and seconds with the largest nonzero unit.
map.快速估算：讲解总时长(秒) = 展品数 × 单件讲解秒数 + (展品数 > 1: Quick estimate: total narration (s) = exhibit count × narration seconds per exhibit + (exhibit count > 1 ? (exhibit count − 1) × walking seconds per leg : 0) + opening/closing seconds; available time (s) = available minutes × 60; time difference = available time − total narration. Time per exhibit = ⌊available time ÷ exhibit count⌋, and exhibit count must be an integer ≥ 1. If exhibit count, narration, walking, opening/closing or available time is blank, negative or fractional (and exhibit count must be an integer), the tool asks for a correction and does not calculate; a negative difference is shown with a “−” sign. Rating: difference ≥ 0 sufficient, ≥ −300 s slightly over, otherwise significantly over. When over, the suggested per-exhibit cut is ⌊(available time − total walking − opening/closing) ÷ exhibit count⌋ seconds (minimum 0), and the suggested exhibit count is ⌊(available time − opening/closing + walking seconds) ÷ (narration seconds + walking seconds)⌋. Detail mode sums actual seconds per exhibit and shows each share = exhibit seconds ÷ total × 100% plus cumulative time. Time formatting: hours = ⌊seconds ÷ 3600⌋, minutes = ⌊(seconds mod 3600) ÷ 60⌋, seconds = seconds mod 60; output “xh ym zs” when hours > 0, “ym zs” when minutes > 0, otherwise “zs”.
map.某团队 5 件展品、单件讲解 120 秒、移动 30 秒/段、开场结束 60 秒: A team has 5 exhibits, 120 s narration per exhibit, 30 s walking per leg, 60 s opening/closing and 20 available minutes. Total = 5×120 + 4×30 + 60 = 780 s (13 min); available = 20×60 = 1200 s; difference +420 s (7 min spare); time per exhibit ⌊1200÷5⌋ = 240 s. If total exceeds the available time, the difference is shown with a minus sign (e.g., −180 s), so it is not confused with remaining time. If exhibit count is blank, 0, negative or fractional, or narration/walking/opening is negative or fractional, the tool asks for a correction instead of truncating and continuing.
map.输入为空或小数时为什么不出结果？: Why is there no result when input is blank or fractional?
map.快速模式的展品数必须是 ≥1 的整数，单件讲解、移动和开场结束必须是非负整数秒；: In quick mode, exhibit count must be an integer ≥ 1, and narration, walking and opening/closing must be non-negative integer seconds. Blank values are no longer treated as 0 and decimals are no longer truncated by parseInt. Missing or out-of-range values produce only a correction prompt, preventing a plausible-looking schedule from invalid inputs.

map.某团队 5 件展品、单件讲解 120 秒、移动 30 秒/段、开场结束 60 秒: A team has 5 exhibits, 120 s of narration per exhibit, 30 s walking per leg, 60 s opening/closing and 20 available minutes. Total = 5×120 + 4×30 + 60 = 780 s (13 min); available = 20×60 = 1200 s; difference +420 s (7 min spare); time per exhibit = floor((1200 − 4×30 − 60) ÷ 5) = 204 s. If total exceeds the available time, the difference is shown with a minus sign (e.g., −180 s), so it is not confused with remaining time. If exhibit count is blank, 0, negative or fractional, or narration/walking/opening is negative or fractional, the tool asks for a correction instead of truncating and continuing.
map.每件可用 = ⌊(可用秒−移动−开场)÷展品数⌋，不足 0 取 0，用于快速判断: Available time per exhibit = floor((available seconds − walking − opening) ÷ exhibit count), floored at 0. It gives a quick read on whether the current per-item setting overruns; if one item far exceeds the average, compress it first. The per-item view also shows each item share and cumulative time, making it easy to trim precisely.
